title: IP Core Register Read
text: Model register writes from software to hardware, 1 output, {Output data type} sets Data type of output data; {Register name} sets the name of register, {Output vector size} sets the vector size of output data and {Sample time} sets the simulation interval of sampling. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Register name
params.values: Name of register RegA (default) | character vector

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of output data uint16 (default) | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | int32 | uint32 | boolean | fixed point data type

params.name: Output vector size
params.values: Vector size of output data 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Simulation interval of sampling -1 (default) | nonnegative scalar
